description: Get a preview of the invoice as the customer sees it: the opening of the finished, laid-out document rather than its underlying fields. Useful for checking how an invoice reads. It is an HTML page, and these pages run to hundreds of thousands of characters, so the first 4000 characters come back and the result says so. For the figures on an invoice use hcp_get_invoice instead. Reading a document does not send it to anyone.
name: hcp_get_invoice_document
